title: The River That Stood Still
reflectionQuestion: The priests had to step into the water before God parted the river. I wonder how it feels to trust God enough to take that first brave step, even before you can see the way?
kidSafetyNotes: Claims OPEN registry anchor jordan_crossing (Joshua). WATCH-ITEM: the STEP OF FAITH is the heart -- the priests step INTO the water BEFORE it parts (trust first, then see). Framed as wonder/trust, NOT a battle (they are entering the promised land/home, no enemies/conquest). Visual replay hooks: water 'piled up in a heap', dry riverbed, twelve memorial stones + the 'tell your children' beat. Pairs with Red Sea (1813) but distinct event. Soft close ('all'). VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH_PROFESSIONAL (clear diction; swapped from ELIJAH_SAGE, which mis-pronounced 'wide').
